name: 26th World Congress of Psychiatry (WCP 2026)
description: The 26th World Congress of Psychiatry is organized by the World Psychiatric Association together with the Swedish Psychiatric Association under the theme Guided by Compassion, Grounded in Science: Psychiatry for Our Time. The programme covers clinical, research and policy topics across psychiatry.

deadlines.label: Session proposal submission
deadlines.note: Official general information page lists 9 February 2026; one aggregator lists 2 February 2026.

deadlines.label: Early registration
deadlines.note: Official page lists 2 June 2026; one aggregator lists 1 June 2026.

deadlines.label: Regular registration
deadlines.note: Late registration rates apply from 19 August 2026.

sources.note: Congress dates 23 to 26 September 2026, Stockholm; regular registration deadline 18 August 2026.
Venue Stockholmsmässan, in person format, session proposal, fellowship, abstract and early registration deadlines.
WPA list of upcoming World Congresses including 2026 Stockholm.
WCP 2025 Prague abstract and late-breaking deadlines (prior edition).

notes: All submission deadlines have passed; registration remains open at the late rate. The congress rotates between regions each year.

name: 27th World Congress of Psychiatry (WCP 2027)
description: The 27th World Congress of Psychiatry is scheduled by the World Psychiatric Association for Cartagena, Colombia. Only the dates and city have been published; a dedicated congress website has not yet been launched.

deadlines.label: Session proposal submission
deadlines.note: Estimated from the 2026 pattern (proposals closed 9 February 2026 for a late September congress, about seven months ahead). Not published.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: Estimated from prior editions (abstracts closed 2 April 2025 for an October congress and 23 March 2026 for a September congress, about six months ahead). Not published.

deadlines.label: Early registration
deadlines.note: Estimated from the 2026 pattern (early registration closed 2 June 2026 for a late September congress). Not published.

sources.note: Lists the 27th World Congress of Psychiatry, 4 to 7 November 2027, Cartagena, Colombia (and the 28th in Taipei, 2028).

notes: Dates and city are published on the WPA site; venue, format and all deadlines are unpublished. The wcp-congress.com domain currently serves the 2026 edition and will probably be reused for 2027.
